source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by pure white)
pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, origin at top-left pixel

camera.motion: static (no background to check against; both objects keep constant image y and constant size, consistent with a fixed camera)
camera.perspective: 2D side view; both objects move horizontally in a plane facing the camera; no ground plane/horizon visible. Apparent sizes are constant over the clip (boat length 856-862 px, shark length 277-283 px).

boat.description: Red fishing boat (trawler) with white wheelhouse/cabin, mast, grey rails at stern, yellow hull text 'AH805', dark-blue/purple lower hull. Upper object, bow pointing LEFT.
boat.partially_out_of_frame: frames 0-25 the stern is cut by the right image edge; in ALL frames the top of the mast is cut by the top edge (y=0), so true height is not measurable
boat.reference_point: ref_x = bow_x + 429 px (half of the full bbox length 859 px), i.e. horizontal bbox centre, valid also while the stern is off-screen. Vertical origin not observable (mast cut); use bow_y or keel_bottom_y as vertical reference (both ~constant).

size_px_frames_26_72.visible_height_y0_to_keel: ~646 (truncated at top edge by the mast)

boat.motion: moves LEFT, near-constant ~17.9 px/frame (~429 px/s) from frame 1 on; no movement between frames 0 and 1. Vertical drift <= ~8 px (bow_y 367->375, keel 641->647).

shark.description: Grey/blue shark with white belly, lower object (y ~852-958), swimming LEFT (snout on the left), tail flaps.
shark.reference_point: ref = bbox centre (origin assumed at body centre); mask centroid also given (less sensitive to tail flapping)
shark.motion: moves LEFT and speeds up steadily: ~7.5 px/frame at frames 2-5, ~12 px/frame around frame 30, ~18 px/frame at frames 68-72. No movement between frames 0 and 1 (mask centroid shift -0.3 px). Vertical position constant (centroid y 905.4-905.8).

static_objects: none (background is uniform white after segmentation)

events.event: both objects at rest relative to frame 1 (frame 0 and 1 identical positions)
start of motion for boat and shark (first displacement occurs between frames 1 and 2)
boat stern fully enters the frame (bbox no longer touches the right edge)
end of clip; both still moving left; boat is above-left of shark, shark snout x=628 vs boat bow x=228

relative_positions: boat ref_x minus shark ref_x: frame 0 ~ +255 px, frame 72 ~ -110 px (the two reference x's coincide at about frame 32, t~1.33 s: boat 1373, shark 1373.5; after that the boat is further left). Vertical separation boat keel (y~643) to shark top (y~852) ~ 210 px.
